title: A memo that says a flagged bike is 95% likely cracked, when 30 of 3,000 bikes are cracked and 5% of the sound ones are flagged

planted.why: with 30 cracked and 2,970 sound bikes the sensor flags 28.5 cracked and 148.5 sound ones: a flagged bike is cracked about 16% of the time, not 95%

proof.python:
tp = 30 * 0.95
fp = 2970 * 0.05
ppv = tp / (tp + fp)
assert 0.15 < ppv < 0.17, ppv
assert '95% likely' in open('memo.md').read()
